measurement.windows: independent_begin CSR through independent_end CSR, occurrence=7*repetition+arm; original selected scope binding convention
measurement.instructions: public architectural custom ISA + FENCE, no synthetic Spike funct127
measurement.input_preparation: outside timing, prepares all3Atiles/B and drains; readout control pre-fills same output then reads clean, dirty arm writes sentinel to same lines
measurement.printing_and_reference_computation: after window; all printing after all21windows
measurement.timings_nonadditive: total/scope timings only; no invented decomposition by subtraction of overlapped stages
measurement.host_control: exact128 dependent integer adds per job, total384, checksum391; no FP inference
measurement.repeat_rule: all21 windows and entireprogram numeric pass; spread>5% anyarm => unstable scope and no qualification until explained
measurement.functional_first: ordinary selected Spike, then sameELF selected observer for all21 exactwindows; no gSIM before root review

acceptance.status: proposed narrow qualification criteria; does not replace existing supervisor gates
acceptance.numeric: zero errors across every output/guard/checksum, ordinary and annotated outputs equal after removing only cycle text
acceptance.runtime: exact ELF/input/model/provider/config/scope pins; timing_complete true, unresolved empty; conditional translation assumptions explicit
acceptance.absolute_scope_error: for each arm median, abs(estimate-RTL)<=max(32cycles,20%RTL); across six device arms median relative error<=15%
acceptance.pair_ordering: queued3/fenced3 predicted ratio relative error<=15%; require correct sign only when observed separation exceeds max(32cycles,5% slower arm)
acceptance.differential: dirty-clean and delayed-base deltas: absolute prediction residual<=max(32cycles,25%abs observed delta); CPU-only median follows absolute scope rule
acceptance.short_control: 32cycle absolute floor is prespecified for tiny windows, not a fitted residual
acceptance.scope_promotion: success permits review of narrow structural gate only; existing4independent groups/two passing variants/identifiability/train/held rules remain for scalar parameter fitting
acceptance.failure: retain deny unchanged; report feature mismatch/unknown, never fit readout residual into WS/preload prices

next_physical: At most1 combined gSIM execution after root approval; bounded job1200s and original ledger. If runtime cannot faithfully select all windows, stop and review rather than silently splitting scope or adding jobs.
